messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — embeddings-service (canary) error-rate spike > 8% for last 5m. Route: /v1/embeddings, 95th latency up. Canary 10% of traffic.

elaine: saw the alert. i'm oncall. switching to incident channel. canary id: canary-2026-04-12-09:15 (rolled 09:10).

raj: on it. which commit rolled?

dana: deploy-bot shows: deploy by raj, commit 9c4f7b2 — change: "support long input streaming for embeddings". rolled to canary 10%, launching at 09:10.

jorge: pulling logs from canary nodes. seeing repeated 500s for inputs > 64k tokens. stacktrace points to kvcache flush path hitting a semaphore timeout.

elaine: customer impact? are prod users affected or only canary?

jorge: small set of customers hitting long-batch ingestion pipelines are experiencing 502/500. error rate for all traffic is ~0.7% but on canary host group it's ~9%. canary traffic = 10% so visible.

sophie: looks like the canary routing policy didn't trigger rollback (auto-rollback threshold is 15% for full rollout) — a manual kill-switch required.

mike: we need a quick mitigation. options: feature-flag kill, revert the one-liner, or scale canary down to 0.

elaine: kill the feature flag for long inputs first. toggle flag: embed-long-inputs -> off. who can flip it right now?

raj: i can. flipping now... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: done. feature flag embed-long-inputs = OFF for canary and prod.

incident-bot: Feature flag change detected: embed-long-inputs toggled to false by raj.

jorge: after flag flip, error-rate on canary dropped to 0.6% in ~30s. latency normalizing.

elaine: good containment. but we still want to revert the commit and push a one-line hotfix to be safe. can we revert 9c4f7b2 and ship hotfix-only to canary then prod?

raj: i can prepare revert. suggested workflow: git revert --no-commit 9c4f7b2; test; git commit -m "revert: disable long input streaming until kvcache fix"; git push origin hotfix/embeddings-revert; deploy to canary.

raj: creating revert branch now.

dana: when you deploy, please include deploy-bot tag so we get automated rolling logs.

raj: pushed hotfix branch and created deploy request. deploy-bot: please canary-deploy hotfix/embeddings-revert -> embeddings-service:canary.

deploy-bot: Job queued. canary rollout to 10% started by raj.

jerome: (reaction) :thumbsup:

jorge: running health check against canary host: curl -i https://canary-embeddings.internal/health -> 200 OK.

jorge: sampling application logs for the last 5m on canary: 
```
ERROR embeddings_handler.go:241: kvcache flush timed out after 2s for session abc123
WARN embedding_stream.go:88: input length 128k exceeds soft limit
ERROR http_server.go:412: handler returned 500 for /v1/embeddings
```

elaine: confirmed: revert_deploy appears clean, error-rate on canary stable <1%. i'd like a quick customer impact assessment and comms draft.

sophie: impacted customers: ingest pipelines with long-batch inputs during 09:10-09:25 window. estimated affected requests ~2.3k, estimated failed requests ~180. potential downstream backpressure for a couple of SaaS customers.

mike: suggest notifying support with this blurb: "We briefly degraded embeddings for long inputs between 09:10-09:25 due to a canary rollout. We've disabled the long-input feature flag and reverted the change; normal service resumed within ~10 minutes. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

elaine: @sophie — create a support ticket template and paste into #support-alerts. include affected customer list and suggested fix actions (retry backfill jobs, contact support if persistent).

sophie: will do. drafting now.

raj: after canary looks OK for 6m, i'll promote hotfix to prod. canary at 10% for 6m target.

jorge: telemetry: post-deploy check — looking for error signatures related to kvcache semaphore and any regressions in p50/p95 latency.

incident-bot: Alert cleared for embeddings-service canary. error-rate back to baseline.

elaine: handoff in 30m to on-call tomorrow. @jorge please add any follow-up ops tasks to the incident tracker. i will file incident ticket in our tracker with initial timeline + remediation.

jorge: will add: (1) add extra telemetry around kvcache flush durations; (2) add graceful degrade path for kvcache timeouts; (3) run load tests with long-input vectors; (4) root-cause analysis to follow.

mike: SRE/prioritization: this needs a fix in next sprint. assign to eng-runtime.

elaine: draft of customer comms posted to #support-alerts and pinned.

sophie: support ticket created: INC-2026-224. list of affected customers attached.

raj: promoting hotfix to prod now after 8m of green canary. deploy-bot: deploy hotfix/embeddings-revert -> embeddings-service:prod

deploy-bot: Deploy to prod started by raj. Rolling update across 5 pods.

jorge: prod health checks passing. sampling logs — no 500s for long inputs after hotfix.

elaine: closing immediate incident. we'll schedule RCA with eng-runtime + infra + ml in 48h. thanks everyone. :clap:

mike: quick note for postmortem — timeline, the flag flip, revert, and deploy took ~18 minutes from page to stable. include detection time and why auto-rollback didn't catch it.

elaine: agreed. i'll own the RCA. handing off to sophie for comms and jorge for runtime fixes.

sophie: adding comms followups and FAQ for support.

jorge: adding RCA checklist items to the ticket.

elaine: if anything else crops up ping me. otherwise incident thread archived in 1h.

raj: thanks team. good catch and fast rollback.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by elaine. uptime-bot note: no SLA breach recorded.
